workflow_runs.display_title: chore(ci): update release actions to Node 24 and pin runner

head_commit.message:
chore(ci): update release actions to Node 24 and pin runner

The release workflows used actions/checkout@v4, actions/github-script@v7 and
actions/setup-node@v4, which target Node.js 20. Node 20 is deprecated on
GitHub Actions runners (migrating to Node 24). Upgrade to the latest action
versions that run on Node 24 (checkout v7.0.1, github-script v9.0.0,
setup-node v7.0.0) and pin the runner image to ubuntu-24.04 to drop reliance
on the moving ubuntu-latest label.

workflow_runs.name: Node CI
workflow_runs.display_title: [v6.x] fix: handle frozen globalThis in setGlobalDispatcher (#5574)

head_commit.message:
fix: handle frozen globalThis in setGlobalDispatcher (#5574)

* fix: handle frozen globalThis in setGlobalDispatcher

When Object.freeze(globalThis) is called before undici globals are accessed,
setGlobalDispatcher would throw TypeError because it cannot extend globalThis.

This fix wraps the Object.defineProperty calls in try/catch. When globalThis
is not extensible (frozen), the dispatcher is stored in a module-level
fallback variable instead. getGlobalDispatcher is updated to return the
fallback dispatcher when the globalThis property is not available.

This allows undici to work correctly even when globalThis has been frozen,
which is recommended by Node.js security best practices (CWE-349).

Fixes issue where Object.freeze(globalThis) breaks undici access.

* test: add unit test for frozen globalThis in setGlobalDispatcher

Add comprehensive test coverage for the frozen globalThis fix. Tests verify:
1. setGlobalDispatcher does not throw when globalThis is frozen
2. getGlobalDispatcher continues to return a valid dispatcher
3. The fallback mechanism works correctly when globalThis is not extensible

This addresses the review feedback from mcollina requesting tests.

* test: improve frozen globalThis test coverage

Add comprehensive test cases to ensure all code paths in the frozen globalThis
fix are exercised. Tests verify:
1. setGlobalDispatcher does not throw when globalThis is frozen
2. getGlobalDispatcher returns a valid dispatcher
3. Fallback dispatcher persists across multiple calls

This addresses review feedback requesting tests.

(cherry picked from commit a0922b0b6b5db878881017abb6fca3bbcdea555a)
Signed-off-by: Mrityunjay Pandey <mrityunjayp1409@gmail.com>

workflow_runs.name: Node CI
workflow_runs.display_title: [v6.x] fix(fetch): error the stream when decompression fails after onComplete

head_commit.message:
fix(fetch): error the stream when decompression fails after onComplete

The body pull loop runs decompression after onComplete has already
fired, but onComplete removed the fetch controller's 'terminated'
listener (onAborted). When zlib fails (e.g. a response declares
content-encoding: gzip but the body is not valid gzip), controller
termination never reaches the response stream, so text(), json() and
stream reads hang forever and the AbortSignal cannot end them.

Register the onAborted listener only once per fetch (guarded by the
presence of fetchParams.controller.resume) and stop removing it in
onComplete. This keeps the listener alive until the fetch settles so a
late decompression failure correctly errors the stream, while avoiding
the MaxListenersExceededWarning on redirects that the single
registration prevents.

Fixes https://github.com/nodejs/undici/issues/5999

Backport of #3754.

Refs: https://github.com/nodejs/undici/pull/3754

workflow_runs.display_title: Backport upgrade diagnostics lifecycle fixes to v6.x (#5833)

head_commit.message:
Backport upgrade diagnostics lifecycle fixes to v6.x (#5833)

* fix: complete upgrade diagnostics lifecycle

Successful CONNECT and protocol upgrades stop before Undici marks the request complete. Diagnostics subscribers retain request state, and streamed request-body listeners remain attached to the upgraded socket.

Publish the existing response lifecycle around accepted upgrades. Preserve the early HTTP/2 CONNECT handoff in v6, and terminate diagnostics if the stream fails before its response.

Refs: https://github.com/nodejs/undici/pull/5783
Signed-off-by: Ruben Bridgewater <ruben.bridgewater@datadoghq.com>

* fix: preserve abort after upgrade handoff

Completing upgrade requests suppresses late request errors, but v6 retains the abort callback as the transport cleanup owner after handoff. Returning early leaves upgraded sockets and HTTP/2 CONNECT streams open.

Signed-off-by: Ruben Bridgewater <ruben.bridgewater@datadoghq.com>

---------

Signed-off-by: Ruben Bridgewater <ruben.bridgewater@datadoghq.com>

workflow_runs.display_title: test: synchronize the issue-3356 body timeout

head_commit.message:
test: synchronize the issue-3356 body timeout

The test races its forced body timeout against both the first response chunk and a native response-completion timer. A byte-zero retry can succeed, while an early response completion can prevent the expected rejection.

An open RetryAgent can also keep server teardown pending after the assertion completes.

Signed-off-by: Ruben Bridgewater <ruben.bridgewater@datadoghq.com>

workflow_runs.display_title: fix: validate coerced header values for CRLF (#5579)

head_commit.message:
fix: validate coerced header values for CRLF (#5579)

Functions bypassed the object guard in processHeader() and were
coerced via template literals without isValidHeaderValue(), allowing
CRLF injection when toString/Symbol.toPrimitive returned embedded
newlines. Validate after coercion on both scalar and array paths.

Signed-off-by: Matteo Collina <hello@matteocollina.com>
